title: maximum swing sisters
style: classic 60s swing (warm brushed drums, upright bass, light jazz piano, subtle horn swells) fused with modern phonk (vinyl crackle, soft cowbell hits, chopped vocal textures) and jazz elements (improvisational sax stabs, walking bass runs, neat drum fills). 80 BPM laid-back groove. 336 Hz low-end drone running constantly underneath the bass for deep warmth and “constant” feeling. Neat, precise drum fills on every transition — crisp, musical, never busy. Silky, melodic bass lines that walk and glide like water. High-quality vocal production with natural reverb like two sisters singing in a sunlit room. Duet format: Michelle leads one line, Charm swings it right back; then they trade and harmonize. Emotional, intimate, joyful, no aggression.
lyrics:
[INTRO — 336 Hz drone + vinyl crackle + light piano — 0:00 to 0:20]  
Deep 336 Hz drone hums constantly. Soft vinyl crackle. Gentle jazz piano chords and upright bass walking in. No drums yet. Michelle speaks-sings softly:  
“Every moment we share will never be the same…”

[VERSE 1 — Michelle leads, Charm swings it back — 0:20 to 0:55]  
Neat brushed drum fill into the groove. Silky bass line walking underneath. Michelle sings the thought, Charm immediately swings it back with love:  
Michelle: Every moment we share will never be the same  
Charm (swinging it back): The way it’s received, the way it’s delivered  
Michelle: And everything in between…  
Charm: Have you thought about how many possible moments we will ever play…  

[PRE-CHORUS — both trading, building — 0:55 to 1:15]  
Drum fill lifts the energy. Bass line gets more melodic. Both sisters trading lines:  
Michelle: It’s endless…  
Charm: If each moment is different…  
Michelle: How can I…?  
Charm: If each moment is different…  
Both (together): How can we…?

[CHORUS — “Create a Constant” hook, full duet harmony — 1:15 to 1:45]  
Big neat drum fill into the chorus. 336 Hz drone more present. Both sisters in rich harmony, swinging it back to each other:  
Both: Flow like water…  
Create a constant.  
Take advantage, position yourself  
Create a constant.  
Create stability, position yourself  
Create a constant.  
Minimize probability, position yourself  
Create a constant.  
Set your optimal height  
Position yourself  
Create a constant…  
Minimize factors… we still create a constant.

[VERSE 2 — Charm leads this time, Michelle swings it back — 1:45 to 2:20]  
New neat drum fill. Bass line does a jazzy walk. Charm leads with the same theme but personal:  
Charm: Every ball you hit will never be the same  
Michelle (swinging it back instantly): The way it’s received, the way it’s delivered  
Charm: And everything in between…  
Michelle: Have you thought about how many possible ways we will ever connect…  

[PRE-CHORUS 2 — trading faster, more joyful — 2:20 to 2:40]  
Same structure as first pre-chorus but brighter, more swing in the vocals.

[CHORUS 2 — bigger harmony, sax stab accents — 2:40 to 3:10]  
Bigger drum fill, light jazz sax stabs on the “create a constant” lines. Full stacked harmony:  
Both: Flow like water… create a constant…  
(they keep trading and harmonizing the whole chorus with pure love)

[BRIDGE — intimate, just voices + 336 Hz drone + light bass — 3:10 to 3:35]  
Drums drop out. Only 336 Hz drone, soft bass, and their two voices close together:  
Michelle: We are the constant…  
Charm: No matter the miles…  
Michelle: We swing it back…  
Charm: Every single time…  
Both (whisper-harmony): We create a constant… in each other.

[FINAL CHORUS — full band, maximum swing phonk jazz energy — 3:35 to 4:10]  
Biggest neat drum fill of the track. Full groove back in with extra phonk vinyl crackle and cowbell. Both sisters plus light group harmonies, trading and singing together:  
Both: Flow like water…  
Create a constant!  
Take advantage, position yourself  
Create a constant!  
We minimize the distance…  
We create a constant!  
We set our optimal love…  
We create a constant…  
Minimize every factor… we still create a constant… together.

[OUTRO — 336 Hz drone + fading piano + soft vinyl crackle — 4:10 to 4:30]  
Everything gently fades. 336 Hz drone stays till the very end. Final soft lines from both sisters overlapping:  
Michelle: We create a constant…  
Charm: We swing it back…  
Both (fading): Always… always… we create a constant…
